Verified at N: :104-112 erase pending_ before run(); :239-243 snapshot the current revision; :313-314 turn a refused defer into DeferralRefused. A second enqueue for the same session (automatic turn completion, or a pressure ask with a new non-empty tag) must land in the microsecond gap between queue pop and the coordinator lock. For an automatic entry pressure is false, so no abandonment occurs and only one transient retry is dropped. For a pressure entry the victim may settle early with a non-None reason and a deferral_refused receipt while the queued run still executes; no durable acknowledgement is fabricated. Shipped F4 left every exhausted persistent refusal Pending forever (reproduced HTTP 503 at 15 s); N settles that path in about 3 s. Fixing needs a new freeze, full native and RTX 5090 rebuild and a restarted multi-hour qualification chain, which is disproportionate to this residual.
